title: timescp
description: This mod adds SCP. Example: SCP1706-JP. When attacking an enemy, it applies an effect to recover and when the effect ends, it deals a lot of damage to the enemy. In addition to this SCP, various other SCPs are added.
body:
Latest version of scpmod Currently implemented scp
- scp-055(wip)
- scp-579(wip)
- SCP-001-JP – Meshiochi's Proposal(wip)
- scp-1244
- scp-5510
- scp-1706
- scp-2195-jp
  
Note: While we understand that SCP-1244's anomaly is not strictly time-stopping, we have implemented it as such due to limitations in replicating its behavior within Minecraft's game mechanics.
“This mod is a fan-made SCP-inspired project. It is not affiliated with the SCP Foundation.”
This mod is a fan-made SCP-inspired project. It is not affiliated with the SCP Foundation.  
While the SCP Foundation content is licensed under CC-BY-SA 3.0, this mod is released under CC-BY-SA 4.0 due to platform limitations.
